name: Hanoi to Ba Be
summary: Ba Be is road only. Take a coach from My Dinh or a car to Bac Kan city, then a provincial road up to the lake. No train serves the park.

modes.note: Coaches on the Hanoi–Bac Kan and Hanoi–Cao Bang lines leave Bến xe Mỹ Đình and often pass the lake. A morning bus also runs from My Dinh to Chợ Đồn, with a van on to the lakeshore. Ask for the current departure and fare when you book.

modes.duration: About 2–3 hours to Bac Kan city. The lake leg is Check on arrival.
modes.note: The Hanoi–Thai Nguyen expressway and then National Highway 3 take about 2 hours to Bac Kan city, cars only. Old National Highway 3 takes about 3 hours and allows motorbikes. From the city it is about 60 to 70 km to the lake, on provincial road 256 or on road 257 via Chợ Đồn.

seoTitle: Hanoi to Ba Be — bus or car via Bac Kan
seoDescription: Getting from Hanoi to Ba Be Lake by coach or car: the two roads to Bac Kan city and the last climb to the park.

faqs.q: How far is Ba Be from Hanoi?
Is there a train or a flight?
faqs.a: No. Nội Bài is the nearest airport, and the rest is road.

faqs.q: What about going back to Hanoi?
faqs.a: Use the same roads in reverse. Ask at your homestay for the current bus departure.
